source.title: Hambur and Freestone (2025), RBA RDP 2025-05: supplementary information (mark-ups and concentration)

concentration.description: Industry concentration from BLADE, as used in Hambur and Freestone (2025), RBA RDP 2025-05 (supplementary 'Inputs/Industry cocnentrations.xlsx'): top-4, top-10 and top-20 firm shares, the top 5 per cent of firms' share and the Herfindahl index, computed within each industry and summarised for each ANZSIC division (and nationally, TOT) as the weighted average across industries (_weighted), the unweighted average (_mean) and the median (_median, null where not given); _industries: the number of industries summarised for that metric. Division HHIs are not published. fyear as labelled by the authors.

markups.description: Harmonic-mean firm mark-ups (price over marginal cost, De Loecker-Warzynski method) by ANZSIC division and for the aggregate (TOT), from BLADE, as used in Hambur and Freestone (2025), RBA RDP 2025-05 (supplementary 'Inputs/markups - harmonic.xls'). fyear as labelled by the authors.
